title: If/Else block asymmetry
description: Lists scripts containing If/Else blocks where the If branch is significantly longer than the Else branch. Candidates for refactoring into early returns or guard clauses.
author: fm-lab custom

params.name: file
params.description: Optional file filter — derived from the app-level filter.

params.name: min_if_len
params.description: Minimum number of steps inside the If branch (default 10).

params.name: max_else_len
params.description: Maximum number of steps inside the Else branch (default 2).
